verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a products-page line saying Plymouth Street plugs into People Ops so 'nothing slips between candidate, manager, and attorney.' That implies an attorney is in the workflow, and the page contrasts its pricing with 'billable hours,' but it names no lawyer and states no attorney-of-record model. Missing for 10: named licensed attorneys on the provider's pages, an explicit statement that attorneys prepare and file petitions as attorney of record, bar-licensure details, and independent corroboration.
